title: Check artifact manifest BUILD identity consistency

orientation.kind: frozen git archive; no Git metadata, worktree, branch, or remotes

findings.failure: Stored qualification identity omits BUILD bun_version and schema; comparable keys are source_sha, binary_sha256, build_sha256, proof_sha256, target.
findings.affected_invariant: source SHA, target, and toolchain identity from BUILD production must remain comparable at proof consumption
findings.smallest_correction: P008/P094: add bun_version to stored identity, or document that build_sha256 is the only toolchain binding and every re-read uses parseProofJson

findings.failure: parseBuildInfo uses JSON.parse (duplicate source_sha last-wins); qualification/go-no-go use parseProofJson (duplicate-json-key).
findings.affected_invariant: hashed BUILD bytes must decode to one identity everywhere
findings.limitation: production JSON.stringify cannot emit duplicate keys; this is a consumer inconsistency on non-canonical bytes

findings.failure: Empty bun_version is accepted by parseBuildInfoValue, rejected as invalid-proof-string by validateArtifactProof, and rejected by go-no-go semver regex.
findings.affected_invariant: toolchain string identity has one grammar
findings.limitation: production Bun.version is nonempty; parser-floor gap, not observed on a produced package

findings.failure: Extra trailing newline in SHA256SUMS passes verifyChecksumManifest (trim) and fails qualification/go-no-go exact reconstruction.
findings.affected_invariant: checksum manifest bytes that cover BUILD.json must verify the same way in every consumer

findings.failure: Proof receipt bun_version is the runner Bun.version, compared to BUILD bun_version rather than copied from it.
findings.affected_invariant: field lineage is must-match, not echo

findings.failure: Production pretty-prints BUILD.json; compact JSON with the same fields has a different SHA-256.
Smoke checks target and bun_version only; source_sha is unused.
